# Auth Me 在 Minecraft 中进行账号身份验证并重新验证您的会话 [![Build](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/axieum/authme/release.yml?branch=main&style=for-the-badge)][ci:release] [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/axieum/authme?style=for-the-badge&include_prereleases&sort=semver)][releases] [![Available For](https://cf.way2muchnoise.eu/versions/Available%20For_356643_latest.svg?badge_style=for_the_badge)][curseforge] [![Downloads](https://cf.way2muchnoise.eu/full_356643_downloads.svg?badge_style=for_the_badge)][curseforge:files]
Auth Me 是一款 **Minecraft 模组**，旨在将账号身份验证功能引入游戏，以解决连接服务器时著名的会话验证错误问题。 它是一款仅支持**客户端**的模组，适用于 [Minecraft][minecraft] Java 版的现代版本。 #### 替代方案 - [ReAuth][reauth_mod] 由 TechnicianLP 开发 - [OAuth][oauth_mod] 由 Sintinium 开发 ## 赞助方 我们衷心感谢以下赞助方对 Auth Me 开发的支持。 [][bisecthosting] ## 参与贡献 感谢您考虑为 Auth Me 做出贡献！请参阅[贡献指南][contributing]。 ## 安全漏洞 请查阅[安全策略][security]了解如何报告安全漏洞。 ## 许可证 Auth Me 是基于 [MIT 许可证][licence] 开源的软件。 [bisecthosting]: https://bisecthosting.com/axieum [ci:release]: https://github.com/axieum/authme/actions/workflows/release.yml [contributing]: https://github.com/axieum/authme/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md [curseforge]: https://curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/auth-me [curseforge:files]: https://curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/auth-me/files [fabric]: https://fabricmc.net/ [licence]: https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT [minecraft]: https://minecraft.net/ [oauth_mod]: https://github.com/Sintinium/oauth [reauth_mod]: https://github.com/TechnicianLP/ReAuth [releases]: https://github.com/axieum/authme/releases [security]: https://github.com/axieum/authme/security/policy
